questions.question: Which of the following ministries implements the Mid-day Meal scheme?

options.text: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

questions.solution:
• **Mid-Day Meal **is a school meal (**Hot meal with milk 2 times a week**) program of the Ministry of Human Resource Development (**MHRD**), Government of India to improve the nutritional status of children.
 
• It is a **Centrally Sponsored Scheme** and the cost is shared 60:40 between the Center and States (It is 90:10 for North Eastern states). 
 
• The Government has also made **Aadhaar mandatory** for students to avail of the Mid-Day Meal Scheme. 
 
• The scheme was launched by former Prime Minister of India, P. V. Narasimha Rao in **1995**.
 
• **Human Resource Development Union Minister is Ramesh Pokhriyal Nishank.**

questions.question: _________ was the **first Muslim ruler** whose empire covered almost the whole of India up to its extreme south.
questions.solution:
• Ala-ud-din Khilji was the first Muslim ruler whose **empire** covered almost the whole of India up to its extreme south. He fought many battles, conquered Gujarat, Ranthambhor, Chittor, Malwa, and Deccan.
 
• He was the second and most **powerful** ruler of the Khilji Dynasty. He implemented price control measures for a wide variety of market goods.The taxation system of Alauddin Khilji lasted for a long period up to the twentieth century.
 
• He was the first Delhi Sultan to resort price control and rationing among the local poor.

questions.question: Which of the following destroys the ozone layer?
questions.solution:
• Chlorofluorocarbons(CFCs) contain **Chlorine**. It reacts with ozone as follows: - Cl + **O₃** → **ClO **+ O₂. The important part is O₃(ozone) gets converted to O₂.(oxygen). CFCs have been phased out. Ozone blocks harmful UV rays from reaching earth. It is present in the **stratosphere**.
 
• **Montreal** Protocol → Agreement among member states to protect the Ozone layer.
 
• Ozone day is celebrated on **September 16th** and 2018 was themed "**Keep Cool and Carry On**".

questions.solution:

questions.question: Who among the following was a slave of Muhammad Ghori? He became the ruler after the death of his master and founded the Slave Dynasty.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Qutub-ud-din Aibak.**__

 
• **Qutubuddin Aibak** became the ruler of India after the death of Mohammad **Ghori** in the year 1206 AD. 
 
• He founded the Slave Dynasty in India and was also known as Lakh Baksh because of his generosity. 
 
• He died in the year 1210 AD while playing Chaugan or Polo.

questions.question: Which was the first Muslim dynasty that ruled India?
questions.solution:
__
 
• Slave dynasty was founded by **Qutubuddin Aibak**__ He is the first Muslim ruler among the given options. He became the ruler of India after the death of Mohammad Ghori in the year 1206 AD.
 
• The very first Muslim ruler of India is Mohammad Ghori who invaded India with the objective of ruling the country. He laid the foundation for Muslim Rule in India and is also known as the 'founder of Muslim Rule' in the country. 
 
• Though he was defeated in the First Battle of Tarain in 1191, he defeated Prithviraj Chauhan in the Second Battle of Tarain in the year 1192. 
 
• Later on, he defeated other rulers of various provinces in India to expand his kingdom. 
 
• Mohammad Ghori passed away in the year 1206 after being attacked in the Dhamyak District of Jhelum (Now in Pakistan).
